mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_approval (run_id, proposal_id, decision, permission_summary, reason, result_status, approved_time, approved_by) VALUES (#{runId}, #{proposalId}, #{decision}, #{permissionSummary}, #{reason}, #{resultStatus}, #{approvedTime}, #{approvedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, proposal_id, decision, permission_summary, reason, result_status, approved_time, approved_by FROM t_ai_approval WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY approved_time ASC, id ASC
